subject: mathematics
content: A man is walking towards a vertical pillar in a straight path, at a uniform speed. At a certain point A on the path, he observes that the angle of elevation of the top of the pillar is 30<sup>o</sup>. After walking for 10 minutes from A in the same direction, at a point B, he observes that the angle of elevation of the top of the pillar is 60<sup>o</sup>. Then the time taken (in minutes) by him, from B to reach the pillar, is :
